tagline: Voya Financial helps Americans plan, invest and protect their savings to improve their quality of life by making a secure financial future possible.
hero_kpi_rationale: The Assets Under Management (AUM) of the Investment Management segment is a key indicator of the size and scope of Voya's asset management activities, reflecting its ability to attract and manage capital for institutional and retail clients.

kpis.name: Assets Under Management (Investment Management)
kpis.explanation: Total amount of assets managed by Voya's asset management division.
kpis.description: Represents the total value of assets that Voya manages on behalf of its institutional and retail clients.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of the size and growth of the asset management business.

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for Voya.
kpis.description: The number of employees is an indicator of the company's operational capacity and scale.
kpis.signal: Indicates the size of the organization and its potential productivity.

kpis.name: Individual Customer Relationships
kpis.explanation: Number of individual customers with a relationship with Voya.
kpis.description: The number of individual customer relationships shows the extent of Voya's customer base.
kpis.signal: Reflects Voya's market reach and penetration among individuals.

kpis.name: Employer and Institutional Client Relationships
kpis.explanation: Number of employer and institutional clients of Voya.
kpis.description: The number of employer and institutional client relationships highlights Voya's presence in the corporate market.
kpis.signal: Indicates Voya's strength in the B2B market and its ability to serve businesses.

kpis.name: Retirement Plan Participant Accounts
kpis.explanation: Number of participant accounts in employer-sponsored retirement plans managed by Voya.
kpis.description: This KPI represents the number of employees using retirement plans provided by Voya.
kpis.signal: Measures the adoption and usage of Voya's employer-sponsored retirement solutions.

kpis.name: Employees Enrolled in Benefits
kpis.explanation: Number of employees enrolled in benefit services administered by Voya.
kpis.description: This figure shows the number of employees using Voya's benefits administration platforms.
kpis.signal: Indicates Voya's ability to administer benefits for a large number of employees.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Amount of capital returned to shareholders through share repurchases and dividends.
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders includes share repurchases and dividends paid.
kpis.signal: Demonstrates Voya's commitment to returning value to its shareholders.

kpis.name: Excess Capital Generated
kpis.explanation: Amount of excess capital generated by Voya.
kpis.description: Excess capital generated represents funds available after covering expenses and investments.
kpis.signal: Indicator of Voya's ability to generate funds beyond its operational needs.

risks.title: Market Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to financial market conditions and geopolitical events, which may affect its business and results. (Item 1A, p. 26)

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: Changes in interest rates may affect the value of the company's assets and liabilities, as well as its results. (Item 1A, p. 27)

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to counterparty default risk, which may affect its results. (Item 1A, p. 28)

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company must maintain sufficient liquidity to meet its debt and expense obligations, which may be affected by financial market conditions. (Item 1A, p. 27)

risks.title: Reputation Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to the risk of loss of confidence from its customers and partners, which may affect its results. (Item 1A, p. 28)

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations, which may affect its results and operations. (Item 1A, p. 29)

risks.title: Risk Management Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company must effectively manage its risks to avoid losses, which may be affected by the complexity of its operations. (Item 1A, p. 29)

ai_positioning.summary: Voya does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
